nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the contract owner, set from msg.sender in the Owned constructor and used in the onlyOwner check.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Lexcoin.symbol public string token symbol (LXC).
Lexcoin.name public string token name.
Lexcoin.decimals public uint8, set to 18 in the constructor.
Lexcoin._totalSupply public uint holding the total token supply.
Lexcoin.balances mapping(address => uint) of token balances; written by transfer/transferFrom and the constructor.
Lexcoin.allowed nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of ERC20 allowances.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance and allowance accounting.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) inside approveAndCall; attacker-controlled callee can re-enter the token.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) in transferAnyERC20Token with an owner-supplied token address.
Arithmetic addition a + b in safeAdd guarded by require(c >= a); overflow-sensitive operation.
Arithmetic subtraction a - b in safeSub guarded by require(b <= a); underflow-sensitive operation.
Arithmetic multiplication a * b in safeMul guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b); overflow-sensitive operation.
Arithmetic division a / b in safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0); division-by-zero sensitive operation.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) public pure, returns a + b with overflow require.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) public pure, returns a - b with underflow require.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) public pure, returns a * b with overflow require.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) public pure, returns a / b with b > 0 require.
Owned() constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner, sets the pending newOwner.
acceptOwnership() public, requires msg.sender == newOwner and promotes newOwner to owner.
Lexcoin() constructor initialising symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and the deployer balance.
totalSupply() public constant returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) public constant returning balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens) public, moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) public, writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) public, debits balances/allowed with safeSub and credits with safeAdd.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) public constant returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) public, sets allowance then performs an external receiveApproval callback.
Fallback function () public payable that unconditionally reverts, rejecting ETH.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) public onlyOwner, forwards ERC20 tokens held by the contract to owner.
